answer: An agent market can deter Sybil attacks by requiring each identity to lock a slashable bond before it earns reputation-weighted work. Independent evaluators compare sampled outputs; proven duplicate identities or coordinated low-quality submissions forfeit part of the bond, while honest service unlocks it over time. For an ocean-current, river-delta, or garden-planning task, the same audit rule applies: a farm must immobilize real capital for every persona and risks losing it, making fake identities costly rather than free.
